# Sundae

Sundae has two peer offerings: Sundae Core for performance and decision intelligence, and Sundae Crew for workforce and daily operations. Payroll (Crew Pay) is a capability within Crew, alongside scheduling, attendance, people records and shift workflows. It is not a third platform family. Core capabilities and optional commercial extensions keep their package-specific scope; a two-offering explanation does not imply every capability is included in every package.

> Sundae provides operations management and decision intelligence for multi-location hospitality and food-service operators. It connects daily operating workflows to accountable action and measured profit recovery.

Sundae helps hospitality and food-service operators run every shift and recover preventable profit loss across every location. It brings workforce operations, daily execution, connected operating data, decision support and measured outcomes into one operating loop: detect, decide, execute, measure, learn.

Sundae does not claim to remove macroeconomic pressures such as wage increases, taxes, rates, or commodity inflation. It helps teams distinguish controllable operational losses, route accountable action, and measure whether margin was protected or recovered.

## Hospitality and food-service operating layer

Sundae Crew is the workforce and daily-operations layer for hospitality and food-service groups. It covers demand-aware scheduling, time and attendance, task and approval workflows, shift communication, HR and people records, tip workflows, payroll calculation and review, employee self-service and workforce intelligence. These workflows can run with Sundae Crew or connect to an HR or payroll system the operator already uses.

The operating layer is connected to Sundae's decision-intelligence products, so a schedule, attendance event, task, handover, payroll cycle or workforce signal can become context for an operating decision and a measured outcome.

## Decision intelligence products

Sundae connects live operations, forecasting, external context, cross-domain analysis, benchmarking, accountable execution, and outcome measurement. Each product below has a distinct role in that operating system.

- [Sundae Core](https://www.sundae.io/core): Decision workspace for evidence, priorities, accountable action, and measured outcomes
- [Pulse](https://www.sundae.io/product/pulse): Real-time restaurant operations, shift exceptions, action tracking, and operational coaching
- [Benchmarking](https://www.sundae.io/product/benchmarking): Anonymized peer context and location comparison across restaurant operating metrics
- [Foresight](https://www.sundae.io/product/foresight): Restaurant demand forecasting, predictive planning, and scenario modelling
- [Watchtower](https://www.sundae.io/product/watchtower): Competitor, local event, weather, and market intelligence for restaurant operators
- [Insights](https://www.sundae.io/product/insights): Cross-domain restaurant analytics across revenue, labour, inventory, purchasing, marketing, reservations, delivery, guests, and profit
- [Cross-Intelligence](https://www.sundae.io/product/cross-intelligence): Connected analysis of relationships between operational signals that are normally reviewed in isolation
- [Ask Sundae](https://www.sundae.io/product/intelligence): Natural-language questions and evidence-based answers across connected restaurant data
- [Profit Recovery](https://www.sundae.io/product/recovery): Governed detect, decide, execute, measure, and learn workflow for preventable profit loss

## Workforce operations for hospitality

Sundae Crew connects workforce execution to the same decision-intelligence layer used for restaurant and hospitality performance. It covers scheduling, time and attendance, people and HR records, payroll calculation and review, employee self-service, and workforce intelligence. Customers can use Crew directly or connect an existing HR or payroll provider.

- [Crew overview](https://www.sundae.io/crew): Workforce operations, HR, payroll calculation and review, and employee self-service
- [Staff scheduling](https://www.sundae.io/crew/scheduling): Demand-aware scheduling, availability, shift swaps, and approvals
- [Time and attendance](https://www.sundae.io/crew/time-attendance): Mobile clock-in, break records, verification, and payroll-ready hours
- [Payroll](https://www.sundae.io/crew/payroll): Multi-country payroll calculation, review, statutory outputs, and provider handoff
- [People and HR](https://www.sundae.io/crew/people): Recruiting, onboarding, employee records, documents, reviews, leave, and offboarding
- [Workforce intelligence](https://www.sundae.io/crew/people-intelligence): Workforce health, no-show risk, overtime, and labor cost alongside sales and demand
- [Restaurant task management](https://www.sundae.io/restaurant-task-management): Opening, closing, recurring and exception work with ownership, approvals and evidence
- [Digital restaurant logbook](https://www.sundae.io/restaurant-logbook): Shift notes, handovers, issues, searchable history and follow-up
- [Restaurant tip management](https://www.sundae.io/restaurant-tip-management): Tip workflows, reviewable calculations and payroll-ready evidence
- [Restaurant management platform](https://www.sundae.io/restaurant-management-platform): Restaurant-management entry point into Sundae's broader hospitality and food-service operating platform
- [Restaurant365 alternative guide](https://www.sundae.io/restaurant365-alternative): Shortlist fit, accounting boundaries, practical workflows and like-for-like cost criteria for multi-location operators
- [Hospitality operators](https://www.sundae.io/solutions/hospitality-operators): Operating intelligence across hospitality F&B outlets and revenue streams
- [HR and people teams](https://www.sundae.io/solutions/hr-teams): Labor visibility and accountable workforce action by shift

## Package scope, pricing and system boundaries

Core and Crew can be evaluated separately or together. Core connects operating evidence and decisions; Crew runs workforce and daily execution. Sundae connects to suitable POS and accounting systems; it does not replace an accounting general ledger. Confirm the actual connector, data scope and country requirements before committing to a rollout.

Every Core package includes Pulse, base Benchmarks, Ask Sundae and Profit Recovery, plus labor, profit and revenue assurance analysis. Package AI seats and credit allowances apply; peer benchmarks need sufficient privacy-protected data, and premium benchmark access has separate eligibility.

Core Foundation provides the operating baseline. Core Margin adds inventory, purchasing and delivery economics. Core Growth adds marketing, reservations, guest experience, guest CRM and delivery economics; it does not include the inventory and purchasing experiences. Core Performance combines Margin and Growth coverage and includes Foresight & Action. Foresight & Action is an optional, separately priced extension for Foundation, Margin and Growth; do not count it twice in Performance.

Watchtower is a separately priced extension only for Core Growth and Core Performance. Choose Competitive Intelligence, Event & Calendar Signals, Market Trends or the full bundle. Eligibility does not mean the extension is included in the Core price.

Crew tasks, checklists and the operational shift logbook require Crew Operations (called Crew Manage in the calculator). Tip workflows use Crew Payroll (Crew Pay), which requires Crew Operations. Crew Operating and Crew Complete include these workflows; Crew Starter and Schedule & Time do not. Scheduling allows viewing manager handovers; creating handovers and using the operational logbook require Crew Operations. Confirm scope in the Crew pages and calculator.

Crew products and bundles use first-location prices plus additional-location bands. Implementation, integration scope, taxes, support, payment schedule and optional extensions affect the comparison.

- [Current pricing calculator](https://pricing.sundae.io): Authoritative current estimate for the selected products and locations
- [Active public pricing catalogue](https://www.sundae.io/api/pricing/catalog): Published database catalogue version, current list rates and included module IDs

Website list-price examples are reviewed snapshots, not contractual quotes. The active database catalogue and scoped estimate take precedence over an old cached rate card or backend fallback configuration. No saving versus Restaurant365 is established by a headline price comparison; request matching scope from both providers.

Crew Pay supports gross-to-net calculation across 36+ ISO countries with versioned country rules, payslips and reviewed statutory exports. Filing and payment handoffs depend on the country and provider; calculation support does not imply automatic filing or disbursement everywhere.
